caption: The drawing features a single fish depicted in a realistic style, positioned horizontally facing to the right. The fish is rendered in shades of gray and black with fine line work indicating scales, fins, and other anatomical details. The body of the fish is elongated, with a forked tail, a dorsal fin on top, a pectoral fin near the gills, and pelvic and anal fins below. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery included. There are some slight discolorations and marks, particularly along the top edge of the drawing. Handwritten notations are present in the upper right corner.
title: Fish Shop Sign
